name: Brahmagupta zero rules
summary: Brahmagupta set out rules for adding, subtracting and multiplying positive numbers, negative numbers and zero, treating zero as a number in its own right.
description: Brāhmasphuṭasiddhānta chapter 18 treats positive, negative and zero quantities in addition, subtraction and multiplication; a multiplied quantity times zero gives zero.
